standards_review.notes: all 8 commit subjects match EPMCDME-#### format

findings.title: RETRIEVAL_BACKEND lacks value validation
findings.problem: RETRIEVAL_BACKEND is declared as a plain str with no Literal/enum constraint.
findings.impact: A typo or unimplemented value silently evaluates as available.
findings.recommendation: Constrain the field via Literal or a field_validator.

findings.title: retrieval_available() cfg parameter untyped
findings.problem: cfg parameter lacks a type annotation.

findings.title: No regression test for RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none boot branches
findings.problem: No test exercises either module-scope conditional.
findings.recommendation: Add a test importing main.py with RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none.

findings.title: Direct tool invocation bypasses retrieval gating
findings.problem: _get_context_tools builds KB/code tools without checking retrieval_available(config).
findings.impact: POST /v1/tools/{tool_name}/invoke reachable via unconditionally-registered tool.router, present-and-failing against AC29.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same guard used in add_context_tools.

findings.title: Codebase Tools catalogue entry not fully hidden
findings.problem: Skipping _merge_code_toolkit may leave an autodiscovered entry visible.

findings.title: Datasource re-index trigger actor not gated
findings.problem: No retrieval_available guard in this file.
findings.recommendation: Add the same guard used at other gated call sites.

finding_status.notes: config.py finalize_settings (model_validator) now raises ValueError when RETRIEVAL_BACKEND is outside {elasticsearch, none}. Verified at config.py:970-975.
retrieval_available(cfg: Config) -> bool now carries an explicit Config annotation. Verified at config.py:1053.

tests/codemie/rest_api/test_main_retrieval_backend_disabled.py runs a fresh subprocess import with RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none and asserts both import_indexes() is never called and index.router routes are not registered, directly exercising main.py:894 and :902.

tool_execution_service.py:312-313 now raises ToolException for KNOWLEDGE_BASE/CODE context when retrieval_available(config) is False, mirroring ToolkitService.add_context_tools; three new tests confirm the guard and the unaffected-when-available path.

Re-investigated against current source (waived from changed_files per dispatch): src/codemie_tools/code/toolkit.py's CODEBASE_TOOLS entry (CodeToolkitUI) contains only the credentialed Sonar tool, unrelated to the ES-backed KB/code-search path. AC29 does not require hiding it; the original concern does not hold.

Re-investigated against fix_evidence and spec.md (waived from changed_files per dispatch): spec.md section 6 ("Remaining entry points") explicitly documents the datasource.py trigger actor as an accepted residual risk, reasoning it has no live trigger path since degraded mode already prevents creating the datasource it would fire for. Legitimate, pre-approved basis for leaving it unguarded; datasource.py itself confirms no retrieval_available guard was added.
